issue.title: test_syntax_activation still imports deleted tests.pager.test_app
issue.description:
# CI failure: pager syntax activation still imports deleted test_app

## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py`

This is a deterministic collection error, not a flake. `tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py:23` still does `from tests.pager.test_app import _pager_screen`, but `tests/pager/test_app.py` was deleted in `c5e8d4e96` (`test(pager): split app tests by behavior`). The helper now lives as `pager_screen` in `tests/pager/_app_helpers.py`.

Independent reproduction at HEAD `c6387f3b6` (same tree as origin/master, unrelated to the `workspace_provider.utils` split):

```text
.venv/bin/python -c "from tests.pager.test_app import _pager_screen"
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tests.pager.test_app'
```

`just check-full` on 2026-09-09 (monitor `68d66pa1d3gt`) reported:

- `ERROR tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py` — `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tests.pager.test_app'`
- `FAILED tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection` — `RuntimeError: pytest -m contract --collect-only failed (exit 2)`

The contract-manifest collect-only failure is the same collection error: pytest collection of the contract set cannot import `tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py`.

Fix: retarget the import to `tests.pager._app_helpers.pager_screen` (or a local `_pager_screen` alias), matching the other post-split pager tests.

Reproduced with python -c import at HEAD c6387f3b6; the same error also makes pytest -m contract --collect-only fail, so test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection fails as a follow-on. Not intermittent.

evidence.note: PROPOSED BY sase-yh.4 note #2: the stitch-recovery combined just check escalation independently hit the deterministic tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py ModuleNotFoundError for deleted tests.pager.test_app, plus its contract-collection consequence. The epic changes do not touch pager tests; this corroborates the post-split import defect.

payload.entry: VERIFIED FIXED ON MASTER at HEAD cef06cdca (2026-09-09) by the sase-y5.12 land agent. This bead's defect was also raised independently as the single PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on phase bead sase-y5.12.2, and I declined to re-file it because the import is already gone: tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py now imports only sase.* modules plus tests-free stdlib/textual names, with no tests.pager.test_app import anywhere in the file, and 'pytest tests/pager/test_syntax_activation.py --collect-only' collects 8 tests cleanly in 2.98s. Commit ff6271e53 rewrote that import to tests.pager._app_helpers about 75 minutes before the sase-y5.12.2 phase worker wrote its note, so that worker was reading a stale workspace. Recording here rather than closing, since this bead is not mine to resolve.
